death_drop.value: signed=int(((lawful+32768.0)/1000.0-65.0)*4.0); chance_per_mille=(-signed*(2 if lawful<0 else 1)) if signed<0 else 0; roll 1..1000 <= chance
death_drop.note: lawful>=31983 -> 0/1000; lawful0 ->128/1000; lawful-32768 ->520/1000. Count max4/3/2/1 at <=-30000/-20000/-10000/otherwise; positive count fixed1, negative draws1..max. Caller owns zone/map/duel/simulation/missing-attacker early returns.

death_item_protection.value: choose all entries first; Adena, nontradable, active-pet amulet -> no loss/no reroll; stack transfers full count, otherwise one
death_item_protection.note: Blessed/equipped status alone does not protect. Caller resolves current item metadata/pet bindings, unequips and transfers. Empty inventory is safe no-op locally; Java nextInt(0) throws.

magic_healing.note: Caster alignment; not target alignment. HpRegeneration.java/MpRegeneration.java contain no lawful modifier. No potion/natural-regen bonus.

classic_status_field.note: Source-level field connection only. Character-list f6 Alignment is a separate message. Mid-world refresh/UI colors/save/reconnect not exercised by this module.
